hypotheses.H1: Contemporaneous 1 s buckets: ΔP = α + β·OFI1 with β > 0 (HAC t > 1.96 on every development day); OFI1 R² exceeds trade-imbalance R² on ≥ 4 of 5 development days.
hypotheses.H2: β ∝ 1/D: across deciles of bucket-mean touch depth, log β vs log D̄ slope has a 95% CI that excludes 0; whether it includes −1 is reported (open-snapshot version shown as the attenuated control).
hypotheses.H3: Lagged OFI predicts ΔP_h out of sample (walk-forward) above the shuffle null at 5% after Romano–Wolf across the horizon grid; the horizon of peak OOS R² is reported.
hypotheses.H4: Event-time sampling (mid-change and volume clocks) beats clock time at matched sample counts: Diebold–Mariano p < 0.05.
hypotheses.H5: Multi-level or integrated OFI beats level-1 OFI and the microprice out of sample: DM p < 0.05; a level is kept only if its marginal OOS R² gain has a 95% block-bootstrap CI above 0.
hypotheses.H6: Taker-order signs show long memory (power-law ACF exponent γ < 1, 95% CI) and impact is transient (fitted propagator kernel decays).
hypotheses.H7: Hawkes intensity features add OOS R² beyond OFI: DM p < 0.05.
